overview_description.description:
Felix Biotechnology is working to accelerate the deployment of novel biotherapeutics to manage infectious diseases.

Felix Biotechnology's bio-therapeutics targets antibiotic-resistant bacteria to manage infectious diseases precisely and effectively, allowing healthcare professionals to manage urgent microbial challenges in human health.

product.name: Phage 1.0
product.description: A treatment for Pseudomonas aeruginosa infections in cystic fibrosis patients, designed to improve lung function, decrease lung microbial load, and reduce bacterial virulence.

product.name: Programmable Therapies
product.description: Therapies that use phages to target and kill resistant bacteria, aiming to combat antimicrobial resistance.

product.name: Felix Platform
product.description: A platform that utilizes phages to treat bacterial infections, particularly in cystic fibrosis patients, by either killing the bacteria or reducing their virulence.
